outlook.statement: Plans to expand advertisement motion picture production segment based on market conditions
Identifying areas to set up multiplexes and F&B stores, developing unique brand name for F&B stores

The Company remains focused on strengthening its presence in the entertainment industry and exploring sustainable opportunities in cinema exhibition, advertisement film production and other related activities. The management will continue to evaluate market conditions and undertake appropriate business initiatives based on their commercial viability, with a focus on improving operational performance and creating long-term stakeholder value.
